name: Montaigne
q: Be always booted and ready to leave
The world is but a perennial see-saw
Do I play with my cat, or she with me?
Highest throne — still our own behind
Speech belongs half to the speaker, half to the listener
The value of life lies not in its length, but in its use
The greatest thing in the world is to know how to belong to oneself
My trade and my art is to live
To enjoy one's being rightfully is absolute perfection
The surest sign of wisdom is constant cheerfulness
He who has learned how to die has unlearned how to be a slave
A soul with no set goal loses itself
We can be wise only by our own wisdom
The thing I fear most is fear
Greatness of soul is to limit itself
